title: Don’t stop flying MSFS 2020! 7 new sceneries reviewed
description:
Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 is still receiving incredible support! In today’s marketplace update, we’re looking at a fresh batch of international rivals, from the high-altitude Himalayan challenges of Bhutan to the tropical jungles of Mexico and the vast landscapes of Patagonia.

Whether you are looking for a premium regional hub or a budget-friendly jungle landing, there is a surprising amount of variety hitting the store today. We break these down into three categories: Premium Gateways, Exotic International Hubs, and Regional Picks.

Airports Featured Today:

- KATW - Appleton International: A highly detailed and optimized regional hub for Wisconsin.
- VQPR - Paro International: A true pilot's challenge! No ILS, no PAPI, just pure daylight visual skill in Bhutan.
- MMTL - Tulum "Jungle" Airport: A massive tropical project from FSDG.
- KMTJ - Montrose Regional: A beautiful non-towered public airport in Colorado.
- ROMD - Minami Daito: An Okinawa outpost (watch our warnings on the detail level here!).
- SAVY - Porto Madryn: A coastal gateway to the UNESCO sites of Patagonia.  
- WIBJ - Japura: A historical Indonesian gateway with custom ground services.

I'll be sharing my thoughts on the detail for each, including some "Buyer Beware" tips for specific sceneries.
